description: Declarative catalog for reusable design rules.

usageEntries.title: Evaluate Design Evidence
usageEntries.description: Register the Design provider with the generic Rules evaluator.

exports.name: DesignContext
exports.description: The minimal context shared by Design rules without prescribing its source.

exports.name: DesignEvidence
exports.description: One provider-neutral design observation supplied by a Design context.

exports.name: designRuleProfiles
exports.description: Declares selectable profiles without adding another executable or composite rule.

exports.name: designRuleProvider
exports.description: Exposes the reusable Design provider through the generic Rules RuleSet contract.

exports.name: DesignRuleProvider
exports.description: The public identity and generic Rules contribution for the Design provider.

exports.name: designRuleProviderManifest
exports.description: Declares the released MIT provider surface without exposing unclassified planned rules.

sourceFunctions.name: observations
sourceFunctions.description: Builds representative PASS and FAIL observations for one frozen rule invariant.

sourceFunctions.name: observation
sourceFunctions.description: Builds one normalized serializable observation without an adapter verdict flag.

sourceFunctions.name: evaluate
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates one rule with a frozen fact at its matching page scope.

sourceFunctions.name: ruleFor
sourceFunctions.description: Finds one frozen rule identity for its focused semantic regression.

sourceFunctions.name: evaluationOptions
sourceFunctions.description: Supplies the exact declared capabilities and scope for deterministic unit evaluation.

sourceFunctions.name: createAccessibilityRules
sourceFunctions.description: Creates the independently owned Accessibility and Semantics rule family.

sourceFunctions.name: definition
sourceFunctions.description: Defines one frozen rule identity with the observations that can support its verdict.

sourceFunctions.name: createAccessibilityRule
sourceFunctions.description: Adapts one declared accessibility invariant to the generic Rules contract.

sourceFunctions.name: evaluateAccessibilityFact
sourceFunctions.description: Resolves one scoped fact into an explicit PASS, FAIL, or INCOMPLETE rule outcome.

sourceFunctions.name: incomplete
sourceFunctions.description: Returns the canonical closed outcome when facts cannot defend a verdict.

sourceFunctions.name: fail
sourceFunctions.description: Builds findings only from observations that explicitly contradict a rule invariant.

sourceFunctions.name: parseAccessibilityFactValue
sourceFunctions.description: Narrows a portable serializable fact value to complete normalized observations.

sourceFunctions.name: parseAccessibilityObservation
sourceFunctions.description: Narrows one serializable observation without accepting incomplete subject evidence.

sourceFunctions.name: isRuleSubject
sourceFunctions.description: Checks the portable subject shape retained in the generic Rules result contract.

sourceFunctions.name: isRecord
sourceFunctions.description: Narrows unknown serializable values before reading their named factual fields.

sourceFunctions.name: evaluateAccessibilityObservation
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates one normalized observation against its frozen Accessibility rule meaning.

sourceFunctions.name: booleanVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates one boolean semantic property when it belongs to the expected observation kind.

sourceFunctions.name: stringVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates a non-empty string semantic property when it belongs to the expected observation kind.

sourceFunctions.name: focusOrderVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Compares normalized focus traversal with the normalized document order it must preserve.

sourceFunctions.name: reducedMotionVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates measured motion while the reduced-motion preference is active.

sourceFunctions.name: landmarkVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates whether a measured landmark has a valid semantic role and name.

sourceFunctions.name: mainLandmarkVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates whether the measured page landmark summary identifies exactly one main region.

sourceFunctions.name: isMainLandmarkCount
sourceFunctions.description: Validates the normalized page-level main landmark count before evaluating its invariant.

sourceFunctions.name: isNormalizedElementOrder
sourceFunctions.description: Validates a non-empty unique sequence of normalized element identifiers.

sourceFunctions.name: listSemanticsVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates whether a measured list exposes list and listitem semantics together.

sourceFunctions.name: buttonLinkVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates whether measured buttons and links expose behavior matching their semantic role.

sourceFunctions.name: statusFeedbackVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates whether a measured dynamic status uses an announcing live-region role.

sourceFunctions.name: textAlternativesVerdict
sourceFunctions.description: Evaluates alternatives for meaningful media and the omission expected for decorative media.

sourceFunctions.name: group
sourceFunctions.description: Creates complete catalog records from one semantically cohesive rule group.

sourceFunctions.name: principlesFor
sourceFunctions.description: Maps catalog IDs to controlled C.R.A.P. facet principles.

sourceFunctions.name: designRuleComposites
sourceFunctions.description: Creates the five planned C.R.A.P. composite nodes from their atomic child rules.

sourceFunctions.name: composite
sourceFunctions.description: Creates the evidence contract for a planned advisory composite.

sourceFunctions.name: designRuleSemantics
sourceFunctions.description: Resolves each planned rule into the evidence contract a provider must satisfy.

sourceFunctions.name: additionalCapabilities
sourceFunctions.description: Adds only the capabilities required by interaction, text, or motion semantics.

sourceFunctions.name: includesAny
sourceFunctions.description: Returns whether a rule identifier contains one of a definition's semantic terms.

sourceFunctions.name: filterDesignRuleCatalog
sourceFunctions.description: Selects planned catalog entries matching every supplied controlled facet.

sourceFunctions.name: matches
sourceFunctions.description: Returns whether an entry facet contains every requested value.

sequenceScenarios.description: Selects planned catalog entries matching every supplied controlled facet.
